arcades.info_text: This time Amazone gave an African wildlife feel to it. It is located on Plaza Pondok Gede 2, 2nd Floor, at the same row as Gramedia bookstore. There are three restaurants near it, so if you feel hungry, you can reach them in less than a minute. This Amazone used coins to take a credit. The coin itself was Rp1.250,- per coin. But now, you can use cards. / There are a lot of children passing the PIU pad, so you have to be careful not to let them disturbing you when playing. On weekend, a lot of students go here after school to have fun, so, if you want to show your skills on music games, that is your time. Oh, and we have PIU community that used to hang out here. / PIU is located right on the front. It uses GX cabinet. Recently, they upgrade the system from ABSOLUTE to Fiesta EX. The monitor is good, and the pad is pretty good too, although it's a little slippery and P2 pad is more responsive dan P1 pad. / As for DrumMania, the monitor's condition changes all the time. There's a time when you can't see the low tom notes, but usually the monitor is in great condition. Everything but the snare is good.
